title: The best time blocking app!
body:
I normally never leave reviews but I love and use this app so much, I felt like I have to! It’s so well thought out without being overwhelming with too many unnecessary functionalities. I love the minimalist design and the option to customize the views. 

Usually the issue with time blocking is that reality doesn’t always follow the plans but this app allows you to modify, delay and adjust things super easily, which makes my time blocking habit very sustainable. 

I think the current branding doesn’t reflect the quality of this product enough so I hope they’ll give it a bit of a refresh too :) otherwise it’s great to see that the app is always improving. A huge thanks to the developers!
author: MervAls

author: Filipe58

title: Very promising
body:
Thanks for a very nice app for time-blocking! 

One thing I would ask is — for a given day, could we have a way to preserve past time-block schedules when we edit them? Please refer to Cal Newport "Time-Block Planner" book to see what I mean. 

I use this template often and preserving past and "failed" time-block plans helps review what went wrong and thus plan more efficiently going forward. I'd really love to have it implemented in an app like yours.

PS: Integration with Todoist would also be great!
author: Gavegean
